name: Joint Optimization of Scene and Calibration Parameters
aliases: Multimodal Optimization of Implicit Scene for SpatioTemporal Calibration
definition: A method for multi-sensor spatiotemporal calibration that jointly optimizes implicit neural scene parameters and sensor calibration parameters (extrinsics and time offsets) using multimodal data (RGB images and LiDAR depth).
summary: Joint Optimization of Scene and Calibration Parameters simultaneously refines neural scene and sensor calibration using multimodal data, distinguishing itself by leveraging a reference trajectory to reduce optimized parameters.
